candidates.previous_gap: P1 covered prefix pruning only, not the all-determined-mismatches discharge.
candidates.proposed_obligation: A discharged negative containment must be valid at character offsets, including variable-width and empty-valued symbolic tokens.
candidates.limits: Start with symbolic token shapes [X,a,Y] and [X,b,Z]; a!=b. Candidate valuation X=aa,Y=b,Z=epsilon is only a hypothesis here.
candidates.next_step: Select the complete discharge-soundness property before constructing a new model; do not extend the prior candidate-fix proof.
candidates.status: candidate; not selected, modeled, verified, or refuted

candidates.previous_gap: P4 checked match_at with one-character-width token valuations, not replacement splitting.
candidates.proposed_obligation: Every generated empty/end/match/copy branch preserves first-occurrence replacement semantics and the cases cover all inputs under the actual pattern guard.
candidates.limits: Must retain nonempty constant pattern, nonoverlapping replacement-all scanning, fresh-tail equations and the first-character copy behavior. Model case-count arithmetic including unsigned overflow separately or explicitly bound it.
candidates.next_step: Inspect pattern admission and iterator initialization; use actual case numbering, not an idealized partition.
candidates.status: candidate; not selected, modeled, verified, or refuted

candidates.previous_gap: No earlier property modeled erasing a request vector while advancing qhead.
candidates.proposed_obligation: Resolved requests are removed, unknown requests retained in order, conflicting verdicts stop, qhead remains in range and pop restores prior queue state.
candidates.limits: Regex bisimulation verdicts may be explicit inputs for this bookkeeping property; this cannot prove the regex oracle.
candidates.next_step: Read vector_erase_trail semantics before translation; preserve same-index reexamination and remove-below-qhead adjustment.
candidates.status: candidate; not selected, modeled, verified, or refuted

candidates.previous_gap: No earlier model covered derivative path-interval mutation or boundary arithmetic.
candidates.proposed_obligation: The active interval suffix denotes exactly the original set minus the excluded interval; retained history and push/pop boundaries stay valid, with guarded endpoint +/-1.
candidates.limits: Proper character-domain intervals and a valid initial suffix are actual preconditions, not assumptions that the result is correct.
candidates.next_step: Retain as dependency context only; select a genuinely changed caller before attributing an obligation to the c3mv delta.
candidates.status: Unchanged implementation at pinned merge base: not eligible as a new-code property entry.

candidates.previous_gap: P8 treated coherence as an external observation; it did not inspect its callback/state safety.
candidates.proposed_obligation: Axiom callbacks may append/reallocate tracking terms without invalidating the saved term/depth; depth updates remain monotone and guarded bounds equal 10^k-1.
candidates.limits: Requires a justified append-only callback contract, finite registration behavior and mathematical numeric bounds; does not establish a decimal parser or AST memory safety by itself.
candidates.next_step: Trace m_instantiate/add_term callbacks and validate actual registration dedup before choosing a faithful finite-state model.
candidates.status: candidate; not selected, modeled, verified, or refuted

candidates.previous_gap: P9 covered only negative decimal thresholds, not preimages of indexing/extraction.
candidates.proposed_obligation: The selected str.at fixed-index and last-index preimages agree with extraction membership for all words, including short/empty words and nullable target languages.
candidates.limits: Focus on the exact selected branches and k<=64 guard. Character membership and epsilon membership suffice only because str.at returns length at most one.
candidates.next_step: Read length/nullable/regex concatenation helpers; retain both successful-character and epsilon branches.
candidates.status: candidate; not selected, modeled, verified, or refuted

candidates.previous_gap: No earlier model checked the new replacement/contains preprocessing rule.
candidates.proposed_obligation: A single-character containment observation is unchanged by first-occurrence str.replace when neither constant needle nor replacement contains that character.
candidates.limits: Must include empty needles and no-match behavior. This is the local rewrite, not a proof of shared-mark traversal, proof production or all parent-blocking gates.
candidates.next_step: Translate actual replace semantics with body-defined first-match search; separately document global applicability guards and ancestor blocking.
candidates.status: candidate; not selected, modeled, verified, or refuted

candidates.previous_gap: P1 excluded dependencies, qhead rewind, append/deactivate operations and trailing.
candidates.proposed_obligation: Substitution updates exactly active matching haystack/needle occurrences, joins justification when touched, rewinds the scan appropriately, and undo restores previous fields and dependencies.
candidates.limits: Value-state/trail modeling alone does not establish C++ alias or allocator correctness; inspect trail helpers and distinguish a null substitution dependency from an empty dependency set.
candidates.next_step: Model a bounded operation sequence with source-faithful update order and genuine trail reversal, not a direct assignment of the expected old state.
candidates.status: candidate; not selected, modeled, verified, or refuted

candidates.previous_gap: No previous property covered witness acceptance or its work/depth bounds.
candidates.proposed_obligation: For selected Boolean regex constructors, three-valued acceptance returns a definite verdict only when supported by all needed branches, and budget exhaustion stays unknown.
candidates.limits: This wrapper property would not establish derivative correctness, ground slicing or full regex acceptance. Preserve shared mutable work and short-circuit order.
candidates.next_step: Define a source-grounded constructor slice and exact work/depth arithmetic before selection; do not use successful child results as proof of entire acceptance.
candidates.status: candidate; not selected, modeled, verified, or refuted

candidates.previous_gap: P5 proved primitive-root minimality, not trichotomy branches or their completeness.
candidates.proposed_obligation: A selected f3 periodic-word branch emits a residual z satisfying Y^N = X^M.z under the branch equations and M,N>=2.
candidates.limits: One-branch soundness is not trichotomy exhaustiveness; preserve prefix/suffix orientation, exponent truncation semantics and constant-base period conditions.
candidates.next_step: Read all helper definitions and caller guards; choose a tractable complete word identity rather than replacing word semantics with unconstrained counts.
candidates.status: candidate; not selected, modeled, verified, or refuted

candidates.previous_gap: No previous model checked recursive substitution expansion termination or cycle invariants.
candidates.proposed_obligation: Expansion terminates and preserves represented words under the weakest caller-justified substitution-graph invariant.
candidates.limits: Observed on_stack.remove(t) occurs before on_stack.contains(t); this alone is not a reachable cycle/crash proof. Acyclicity may be maintained by callers.
candidates.next_step: Trace every substitution producer before modeling; separate malformed-state behavior from reachable release behavior. Do not mask an unbounded loop with an invented fuel counter.
candidates.status: candidate; not selected, modeled, verified, or refuted

candidates.previous_gap: P7 proved only child-verdict aggregation, not cache/core entailment or watch representation.
candidates.proposed_obligation: A cache hit is justified by a valid stored unsat core actually contained in the current semantically active facts, and excluded live facets block unsafe caching.
candidates.limits: Must trace provenance of conflict dependencies; do not assume leaf-subset filtering implies semantic unsatisfiability. Canonical clone pointers and live pointers are distinct representations.
candidates.next_step: Inspect vector contains semantics, clone/equality rules, dependency construction and watch-list mutation. Potential missed cache hits are performance observations, not logical failures.
candidates.status: candidate; not selected, modeled, verified, or refuted

candidates.previous_gap: P8 excluded complete model reconstruction and nested power-token processing.
candidates.proposed_obligation: Generated power delimiters are balanced, starts/exponents stacks never underflow, and rebuilt values preserve dependencies and sequence denotation.
candidates.limits: Cannot prove safety by assuming arbitrary external token streams are balanced without tracing the actual producers. AST reference/GC lifetime is a separate obligation.
candidates.next_step: Trace slot producers and retain nested scopes, empty bases and exponent semantics before a dedicated later batch.
candidates.status: candidate; not selected, modeled, verified, or refuted

candidates.previous_gap: P9 excluded nonnegative decimal languages and numerical bound propagation.
candidates.proposed_obligation: Saturating length sums and conditional upper bounds never underestimate actual words; separately, positive-threshold decimal languages must handle leading zeros and magnitude boundaries.
candidates.limits: These are TWO distinct future properties, not one selected whole property. Need actual add_truncate and decimal constructor semantics; do not reuse P9 conversion assumptions as a parser proof.
candidates.next_step: Split into separate entries if selected later; retain UINT_MAX sentinel behavior, numeral-size budget and loop indexing.
candidates.status: candidate; not selected, modeled, verified, or refuted

P6.scope: fresh string length scan after sorting only
